seeded-notebook-library.evidence: Six local .livemd notebooks appear in the Open storage browser: Weekly Delivery Review, Release Readiness, Incident Follow-up, nested-tabs-check, Form Change Check, and Number Limits Check.

built-in-elixir-notebook.evidence: Weekly Delivery Review, Release Readiness, and Incident Follow-up use deterministic standard-library Elixir code without Mix dependencies. The nested-tabs, form-change, and number-limits notebooks instead install Kino (~> 0.19.0) during setup evaluation.

nested-tabs-notebook.evidence: Seeded notebook nested-tabs-check.livemd renders nested Kino.Layout.tabs: outer Alpha/Beta with inner One/Two inside Alpha, distinct literal content per tab.

mid-name-substring-notebooks.evidence: Seeded fixture weekly-delivery-review.livemd is visible in the file picker; its name contains the substring 'delivery' after the first character.

file-picker-notebook-selection.evidence: Seeded fixtures weekly-delivery-review.livemd and incident-follow-up.livemd are visible and selectable in the home file picker; incident-follow-up.livemd contains an evaluable queue delay review cell.

form-change-report-notebook.evidence: Seeded notebook form-change-check.livemd renders a preferences form (display name default Ada, team select, notify checkbox, items-per-page default 10) with report_changes and submit, plus a status output showing 'No changes yet.' until the first edit, then Draft lines per change and Saved lines per submit.

number-limits-notebook.evidence: Seeded notebook number-limits-check.livemd renders an order form with a quantity number input (min 1, max 10, step 1, default 5) with report_changes and submit, plus a status output showing 'No changes yet.' until the first edit, then 'Draft: quantity N' lines per change and 'Saved: quantity N' lines per submit.
